body: Commit 5502f78 (+ CHANGELOG 02b2f3f): team wipe no longer ends the match -- teams with no owned node now respawn at a permanent graveyard instead of staying dead forever. Match win condition replaced team-wipe with an Arathi-Basin-style resource race (arena_tick_resources, capped meter filled per-tick based on nodes owned). Respawns switched from per-hero countdown to a global 30s wave timer -- all dead heroes on a team come back together when it wraps. Added a first-pass node-capping heuristic to the networked bot AI, a resource-race HUD bar client-side, and wire sync for resources[2]. 4 invalidated tests rewritten, 4 new tests added, full suite green, live-verified via two isolated (non-pool) direct-connect 20-bot matches with no crashes.
title: S170-153/154: graveyards + Arathi-Basin resource-race win condition + 30s wave respawns
